## Goal

The asset-local Vulkan window shows the raster workspace of mock-raster.html as one coherent frame: the menu bar with the 19 titles of STU-SHL-011, the document tab strip, the Context Bar, the Tool Rail with the 19 raster slots, the collapsed Browse and Time & Results docks as icon rails, the Viewport with rulers and the spine's document, the Inspect Dock with its three groups (Properties and Colour as empty states, Layers as the spine built it), and the status bar, at the layouts.json sizes under the fit_table ladder, at any window size and scale. Every interactive control answers: a rail slot picks one tool id, a group tab switches its group, and every control not built yet answers `not_implemented_yet` (the STU-SHL-051 reason code NOT_IMPLEMENTED_YET, 14:31909-31911) in the status bar and the receipt, never silence. Chrome stays the CPU painter (O6) with the statement `cpu painter, Vulkan UI pass pending` (scene.rs:9). Recorded deviations, as the spine's: STU-SHL-110 (14:32387) steps SHL-P-01, SHL-P-08 and SHL-P-10 (14:32391, :32398, :32400) have not passed, and STU-SHL-112 (14:32420) says no menu before SHL-P-08, so the menu titles are a static stand-in of the closed list and the docks are fixed; STU-SHL-004 (14:31497) gives the menu bar to the shell, so in the asset-local host the bar is a host stand-in.

research_basis.selected_approach: A pure frame function in hsk-studio-native-host (feature document) turns the client extent, scale and the raster preset data into every band and region rect and the fit decisions; kumihimo-ui gains additive roles, node seams, a ruler paint, component widgets, fit helpers, a partition check and the designer's icons as CPU masks. One Panel per region builds each band with those widgets; a measure pass before the build decides menu-title padding, tab overflow and middle ellipsis. The command table answers every control: rail picks and group tabs change view state, the spine's Layers commands are untouched, and every unbuilt control answers not_implemented_yet. studio.dock.state and studio.tool.active carry the state as strings. Proof: tree checks and pixel scans at the scale matrix, the 1920x1080 band rects against the mock generator and 1280x720 against fit_table, offscreen and quiet-window captures with equal hashes, and an independent designer comparison against mock-raster.html.
research_basis.not_researched: Vendor tool layouts were not re-researched: the designer's own basis stands (design-system.json research_basis, S/research/app-inspect-*.md, adobe-behavior.md). No public WinUI MenuBar guidance on narrow widths or long titles was found (search 2026-11-07); only NavigationView overflow docs. The font the mock rendered with is UNVERIFIED. The CPU repaint and upload cost per hover at 1920x1080 is not measured.
